missed_absorption.label: Missed absorption
missed_absorption.description: Predicted detour or reflection but ray was actually absorbed. Model failed to check for an atom directly in the ray's forward path before checking for diagonal deflections.

missed_reflection.label: Missed reflection
missed_reflection.description: Predicted detour or absorption but ray actually reflected. Model failed to recognize the reflection condition: atom diagonally adjacent to the entry point, or atoms on both sides causing reversal.

false_absorption.label: False absorption
false_absorption.description: Predicted absorption but ray actually deflected or reflected. Model incorrectly identified an atom in the ray's forward path, or confused a diagonal atom with a forward atom.

false_reflection.label: False reflection
false_reflection.description: Predicted reflection but ray actually deflected or was absorbed. Model incorrectly identified a reflection condition at the entry point.

deflection_direction_error.label: Deflection direction error
deflection_direction_error.description: Both predicted and actual are detours, but ray exits on a different side entirely. Model identified that deflection occurs but sent the ray in the wrong direction (e.g., deflected south instead of west).
deflection_direction_error.pattern: predicted detour(side-A) → actual detour(side-B), A ≠ B

off_by_one_error.label: Off-by-one path error
off_by_one_error.description: Both predicted and actual are detours exiting the same side, but at adjacent positions (off by exactly 1). Likely a coordinate indexing error in cell-by-cell ray tracing, or confusion about which cell the ray exits from after a deflection.

large_path_error.label: Large path tracking error
large_path_error.description: Both predicted and actual are detours exiting the same side, but positions differ by 2 or more. Multiple accumulated errors in cell-by-cell ray tracing.

ray_path_error.label: Ray path error
ray_path_error.description: Misinterpreted ray results, traced paths incorrectly in mental model

constraint_tracking_error.label: Constraint tracking error
constraint_tracking_error.description: Failed to maintain or update candidate positions from earlier rays

belief_updating_error.label: Belief updating error
belief_updating_error.description: Had contradicting evidence but failed to revise hypothesis

premature_commitment.label: Premature commitment
premature_commitment.description: Locked onto atom positions too early
